newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks edge higher in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks edge higher in moderate trade.

text.p: Bahrain's shares ended the week to Thursday higher in moderate trade focused on banks and investment companies, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index rose 4.42 points to 1,492.52 points from 1,488.10 points the previous week.
The number of shares traded ebbed to 6.3 million from last week's 7.3 million. Shares of 19 companies changed hands in 160 transactions.
Banks accounted for 35 percent of total trading value of 1.3 million dinars ($3.4 million), up from 1.6 million dinars a week earlier.
Bahrain International Bank led trading, accounting for 13 percent of value dealt. It was last quoted at 157 fils.
